tools_helpful.evidence: Migration log shows pages copied verbatim then namespace-rewritten; build came up clean with no CS errors in session-log.txt.
Used as the mandatory gate; build healthcheck + smoke launch passed, app launched (pid present) and both scenario pages rendered in the WinUI UIA tree.

tool_limitations.limitation: Validated build + text fidelity but had no check for UI Automation identity, so the migrated interactive controls shipping with empty AutomationId went undetected.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Add a WARN check for named interactive controls lacking AutomationProperties.AutomationId.

special_apis.special_handling: Device-gated; with no camera the app correctly reports 'No source groups found' and leaves Start/Stop disabled — matches UWP behaviour, not a defect.

dev_agent_struggles.where: Scenario2 ComboBoxes (Source Group / Frame Source / Media Format)
dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Controls present and wired with x:Name but reported empty AutomationId/Name to UI Automation, so parity coverage scored 2/5 and scenario 2 was held at partial.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: n/a (silent — never surfaced as an error to the agent)
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: In WinUI 3, x:Name is not projected as the UIA AutomationId; the migration skill never instructs adding AutomationProperties.AutomationId, so named controls migrate with no automation identity.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved by the agent — undercounted in scoring.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Migration skill prose (PATTERNS.md) instructing AutomationProperties.AutomationId on interactive controls + a validator WARN that flags named interactive controls missing it.

missing_tooling.need: A validator signal that named interactive controls lack AutomationProperties.AutomationId.
missing_tooling.would_have_saved: Scenario 2 partial→pass; the gap was invisible to a build-only gate.

env_issues.issue: WinUI 3 PNG screenshots captured blank (hardware-composition swapchain not grabbable via PrintWindow/BitBlt).
env_issues.workaround: Eval used the UIA tree instead of pixels; this is an eval-side limitation, not a migration defect.
